title: blob-server: Blob/get handler
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B7. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Implement handle_blob_get in get.rs per docs/design/blobext.md §5 'Blob/get' steps 1-6 and the common start (BlobMode Conflict -> invalidArguments, decision 11; accountNotFound; accountNotSupportedByMethod). blobext-03 §5: ids null -> invalidArguments (gap c); default {data,size} only when offset and length are null, else invalidArguments (gap g); `id` accepted in properties (decision 1); unknown names and unadvertised digest:* -> invalidArguments (also in dataSourceProperties, checked even without chunks); isTruncated/isEncodingProblem; digests over the returned octets via stored_digest then digester, serverFail when an advertised algorithm has neither; imageData; chunks with computed position and per-chunk digests. RFC 9404 mode behaviour is B11. Acceptance: tests/get.rs covering every case in blobext.md §10 'server, Blob/get', with -03 §9.2 verbatim and RFC 9404 §4.2.1 digest vectors.
